module origen_134216 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire start,
    input wire mode,
    input wire valid_in,
    input wire [63:0] key,
    input wire [63:0] iv,
    input wire [63:0] data_in,
    output reg [63:0] data_out,
    output reg valid_out,
    output reg ready
);

    // DES module instantiation
    reg [63:0] des_in, des_key;
    wire [63:0] des_out;
    wire des_ready;

    // Assuming the DES module is defined elsewhere or needs to be implemented
    // For now, we'll create a placeholder module
    des_placeholder des_inst (
        .clk(clk),
        .rst_n(rst_n),
        .start(start),
        .mode(mode),
        .key(des_key),
        .data_in(des_in),
        .data_out(des_out),
        .ready(des_ready)
    );

    // Internal registers
    reg [63:0] current_iv;
    reg [1:0] state;
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00, PROCESS = 2'b01, OUTPUT = 2'b10;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            current_iv <= 64'b0;
            data_out <= 64'b0;
            valid_out <= 1'b0;
            ready <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (start) begin
                        current_iv <= iv;
                        state <= PROCESS;
                        ready <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end

                PROCESS: begin
                    if (valid_in) begin
                        des_key <= key;
                        if (mode == 1'b0) begin // Encryption
                            des_in <= data_in ^ current_iv;
                        end else begin // Decryption
                            des_in <= data_in;
                        end
                        state <= OUTPUT;
                    end
                end

                OUTPUT: begin
                    if (des_ready) begin
                        if (mode == 1'b0) begin // Encryption
                            data_out <= des_out;
                            current_iv <= des_out;
                        end else begin // Decryption
                            data_out <= des_out ^ current_iv;
                            current_iv <= data_in;
                        end
                        valid_out <= 1'b1;
                        state <= IDLE;
                        ready <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end

                default: state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
